FortSetting.AmpleHammer_SettingDescription:
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">ON</>: Your child can interact with AI features in Epic Games products through voice and free-text written communication. This includes interacting with conversational AI non-playable characters in Fortnite

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">OFF</>: Your child cannot interact with AI features in Epic Games' products through voice and written communication.

Note: This control does not apply to AI-powered support interactions.
FortSetting.AllowPaidRandomItemsSetting_Description:
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">On</>: Your child CAN spend V-Bucks (or content purchased with V-Bucks) on items or content where the reward is random. 

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Off</>: Your child CANNOT spend V-Bucks (or content purchased with V-Bucks) on items or content where the reward is random.
FortSetting.AllowCreativeExperiences_Desc:
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">On</>: Your child can design games and experiences in Fortnite, and can join their friends while they design their own experiences.

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Off</>: Your child cannot design games and experiences in Fortnite, and cannot join their friends while they design their own experiences.

Note: While designing a Fortnite experience, players can interact with content that has not been submitted to Fortnite Publishing for moderation and thus has not been rated. Players may also create content, including text, which may be visible to their collaborators. 

Learn more about Creative at fn.gg/creative.
FortSetting.PredownloadCosmetics_InstallSize: <text color="FFFF00">Enabling Pre-Download Cosmetic Textures will use {InstallSize} more storage capacity.</>
FortSetting.AnnualRefundTokenRequests_Description:
<text size="22">Cancel Purchase</>

You may cancel any unintentional purchase made with V-Bucks. Cancel Purchase is available until you equip or use your purchase during gameplay. Only items purchased within the last 24 hours are eligible for Cancel Purchase.

For more info see fn.gg/cancelpurchase

<text size="24">Returning Purchases</>

In cases where you unintentionally purchase an item with V-Bucks and purchase cancelation is no longer available, you can use one of your 3 annual Return Tickets instead. You’ll receive one additional Return Ticket every 12 months, up to a maximum of 3. Each ticket is added 12 months following the most recent ticket you received.

Only items purchased within the last 30 days are eligible for returns. Consumable items - such as the Battle Pass, Battle Pass Levels, or Llamas - are not returnable.
FortSetting.ScopedSpeedMultiplier_Description: A multiplier that is applied to the look sensitivity when aiming down sights with scoped weapons.  Settings less than 1x will decrease sensitivity when aiming down scope.  Settings greater than 1x will increase sensitivity when aiming down scope.
FortSetting.LookBuildModeMultiplier_Description: A multiplier that is applied to the look sensitivity when in build mode.  Settings less than 1x will decrease sensitivity when in build mode.  Settings greater than 1x will increase sensitivity when in build mode.
FortSetting.LookEditModeMultiplier_Description: A multiplier that is applied to the look sensitivity when in edit mode.  Settings less than 1x will decrease sensitivity when in edit mode.  Settings greater than 1x will increase sensitivity when in edit mode.

FortSetting.UseLatencyFlash_Description: A white box will appear when clicking the left mouse button to assist measuring system latency. Requires an NVIDIA video card and the latest drivers.
FortSetting.GyroV2Acceleration_Description:
Acceleration lets you increase your aim sensitivity when turning the controller quickly.

Acceleration can give you a wider range of movement while still keeping your sensitivity low when you want to keep your aim steady. Acceleration is capped so that your fast movements are still consistent and predictable. Selecting CUSTOM will give you more control over the acceleration cap and where it's applied.

The LEGACY option is for those who want their gyro acceleration to feel the same as it did in older versions.

FortSetting.AutoDownloadHighResTexturesReminders_Des:
Allows reminders to be shown regarding turning automatic downloads of high resolution textures back on.

NOTE: Reminders only appear when you have the required hard drive space to enable this feature and automatic downloads are turned 'OFF'.

OFF: Fortnite will not send reminders about enabling high resolution textures.

ON (default): Fortnite will send reminders about enabling high resolution textures.

FortSetting.LockPrimaryInputMethodToMouse_Descriptio: Allows using Controller Input and Mouse Input together, and locks the input feedback to Mouse and Keyboard suggestions, rather than having the input methods fight.
FortSetting.EnablePreferredItemSlots_Description:
Allows you to assign a preferred inventory slot for a weapon or item type. On pick up, your preferred item will be placed into its preferred inventory slot.

Unassigned items will be placed in the first available quickbar slot and rearranged if a preferred item type is picked up. 

• Rarity swapping will occur when picking up a higher rarity like-for-like item. Eg. Uncommon Pump Shotgun will swap for an Epic Pump Shotgun. The lower rarity item will be relocated to the first available slot.

• Auto-Sort Consumables to Right will continue to work with Preferred Item Slots.

• Preferred item slots will only be active when you have at least one empty inventory slot.

FortSetting.InstalledTextureQuality_Description:
Choose the level of detail for Fortnite’s textures. Increasing this setting will make Fortnite stream in textures as they are encountered in-game and look more detailed, but may increase network usage and decrease performance on your device.

<text color="FFFF00">’Cellular Data Download’ must be set to ‘ON’ in order to use higher quality textures over cellular data.</>
FortSetting.Hitmarkers_Description: Choose which sounds play when hitting a target.
FortSetting.TextChat_Desc:
Choose who your child can send and receive messages with in groups, parties, and games. Your child can only send and receive one-on-one messages with Epic friends.

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Everybody</>: Your child can text chat with everyone.

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Friends, team members, and connections</>: Your child can text chat with Epic friends, platform friends{0}, everyone on their team, and connections. Connections are people who your child isn't friends with but who are connected to your child through their friends. Team sizes vary by experience and can range from a few players to everyone in a game.

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Friends Only</>: Your child can text chat only with their Epic and platform friends.

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Nobody</>: Your child can't text chat with anyone.

Selecting <strong>Nobody</> still allows players to use messages from a list of in-game safe phrases (like "Nice one!"), if supported.

FortSetting.AutoHurdle_Description:
Control how your player hurdle.

Hold Forward - Automatically hurdle over small obstacle.
Press Jump - Manually start hurdle over obstacle when pressing jump.
FortSetting.AutoClamber_Description:
Control how your player mantles and grabs onto ledges.

Hold Forward in Air - Jump and Hold Forward to grab onto a nearby ledge.
Hold Jump in Air - Jump and Hold jump to grab onto a nearby ledge.
FortSetting.SocialPrivacy_MutualFriends_Description:

<strong>PRIVATE</>: No one can see your mutual friends.

<strong>FRIENDS ONLY</>: Only friends can see your mutual friends.

<strong>PUBLIC</>: Anyone can see your mutual friends.

FortSetting.GlobalMaxAspectRatio_Description:
Determines how the HUD adapts to ultra-wide monitors.

Expand: Expands the HUD to match your ultra-wide monitor. This results in the HUD displaying towards the edges of the screen.

Clamp: Keeps all HUD elements positioned within a standard 16:9 safe area while still displaying gameplay in ultra-wide.
FortSetting.VoiceChatMethod_Description_ToggleVoice:
Determines whether your microphone is an <strong>open mic</>, or requires a <strong>toggle button</> to activate/deactivate.

<strong>OPEN MIC:</> Your microphone is always on and your teammates can hear you at all times.

<strong>TOGGLE VOICE:</> Other players will only hear you talking when you activate your microphone by tapping the "Toggle Voice" button.
FortSetting.VoiceChatMethod_Description_Controller:
Determines whether your microphone is an <strong>open mic</>, or requires a button <strong>push to talk</>.

<strong>OPEN MIC:</> Your microphone is always on and your teammates can hear you at all times.

<strong>PUSH TO TALK:</> Your microphone is only on and teammates will only hear you talking when you press and hold the 'push to talk' button. The push to talk button can be set in the Controls tab.
FortSetting.VoiceChatMethod_Description_KeyboardCont:
Determines whether your microphone is an <strong>open mic</>, or requires a button <strong>push to talk</>.

<strong>OPEN MIC:</> Your microphone is always on and your teammates can hear you at all times.

<strong>PUSH TO TALK:</> Your microphone is only on and teammates will only hear you talking when you press and hold the 'push to talk' button. The push to talk button can be set in the Keyboard Controls tab.
FortSetting.ControllerPlatform_Description: Determines which controller platform to use when displaying bindings.
FortSetting.AllowedConfrontationalEmoteSources_Descr:
Determines which players you will see overly confrontational emotes from.

<strong>FROM ANYONE:</> You will see these emotes from all players.

<strong>FROM FRIENDS IN PARTY:</> You will only see these emotes from friends in your party.

<strong>NEVER:</> You will not see these emotes from other players.
<strong>Emotes:</>
	<strong>•</> Laugh It Up
	<strong>•</> Take the L
	<strong>•</> Whip Crack
	<strong>•</> Make It Plantain
	<strong>•</> Trophy Drop
	<strong>•</> Feel It
FortSetting.GamepadVibrationBlocksDevice_Description: Disables device vibration when a controller is attached.
FortSetting.GyroDisabledWhileDriving_Description: Disables gyro aiming while in the driver's seat of a vehicle.
FortSetting.Resolution_Description: Display Resolution determines the size of the window in Windowed mode. In Fullscreen mode, Display Resolution determines the graphics card output resolution, which can result in black bars depending on monitor and graphics card. Display Resolution is inactive in Windowed Fullscreen mode.
FortSetting.CosmeticStreaming_Description:
Download only the necessary cosmetics when you encounter them while playing.

NOTE: Slower internet connections may experience performance issues when the game is streaming cosmetics. Turning this feature off will require more disk space.

ON: Fortnite will only download cosmetics encountered in-game.

OFF: Fortnite will download all cosmetics.
FortSetting.CanSeeOtherPlayersNames_Desc:
During a match, the account names of players who are eliminated will appear on the screen.
This setting allows you to replace the names of other players who are not in your squad with "Player" in those messages.

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Note</>: You will still be able to see the names of people in the same "squad" (up to three other players on your team who may or may not be friends).
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">On</>: You will see the names of players that are not squad members.
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Off</>: Replaces the names of players that are not in your squad with "Player"
FortSetting.CanDisplayMyUserName_Desc:
During a match, the account names of players who are eliminated will appear on the screen.
This setting allows you to replace your name with "Anonymous" in these messages for everyone who is not in your squad.

<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Note</>: People in the same "squad" (up to three other players on your team who may or may not be friends) will still be able to see your account name.
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">On</>: Players that are not in your squad will be able to see your account name.
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">Off</>: Replace your name to players that are not in your squad with "Anonymous".
FortSetting.ShowSeasonLevel_Description:
During a match, your account name will show your Season level in the Elimination Feed.

This setting allows you to hide your Season level in those messages.

ON: Shows your Season level to players that are not in your squad.

OFF: Your Season level will be hidden for players that are not squad members.
FortSetting.DynamicResOnlyWithTSR: Dynamic resolution is only available with TSR in the Anti-Aliasing and Super-Resolution settings.
FortSetting.DynamicResOnlyWithD3D12: Dynamic-resolution is only available when DirectX 12 is supported.
FortSetting.DynamicResOnlyWithBelowNative: Dynamic-resolution is only available when setting a 3D resolution lower than 100%.
FortSetting.DynamicResOnlyWithFrameRateLimit: Dynamic-resolution is only available when setting a Frame Rate Limit.
FortSetting.VisualEffectQuality_Description: Effects determines the quality of visual effects in game. Increasing this setting will increase the quality of visual effects, but can reduce performance.
FortSetting.HeadphoneMode_Description: Enable binaural audio.  Provides 3D audio spatialization, so you can hear the location of sounds more precisely, including above, below, and behind you. Recommended for use with stereo headphones only.
FortSetting.QuickWeaponToggle_Description_Switch:
Enable the experimental Quick Weapon action. When enabled, Quick Weapon replaces the Next Weapon button.

Press Quick Weapon to equip your primary item. Press one of the A/B/X/Y buttons while pressing Quick Weapon to switch to one of the other item slots. You can press Quick Weapon and A/B/X/Y simultaneously to swap to that item instantly, or hold the Quick Weapon button for as long as you like to get used to how the A/B/X/Y buttons match up with the items in your inventory.

When this is enabled, Previous Weapon is replaced by Place Marker to make it easier to communicate with your squad. Or you can replace Previous Weapon with the action of your choice by customizing your controls in the Controller Customization tab.

FortSetting.GamepadFlickStick_Description_Switch:
Enables Flick Stick. When enabled, point the Right Stick on your controller in any direction to quickly flick the camera to face that direction. For example, pulling the Stick back will flick behind you. Once the Stick is tilted, rotate it to adjust your bearing.

Since this means you can no longer aim up and down with the Stick, it's best to have Gyro Aiming always active or set Right Stick Effect to ENABLES so that you can activate gyro to look up or down at any time by engaging the Stick.

FortSetting.AutoDownloadHighResTextures_Description:
Enables Fortnite to automatically download high resolution textures. Higher resolution textures make Fortnite look more detailed.

NOTE: Slower internet connections or devices with limited hard drive space may experience performance issues when the game is downloading high resolution textures. Turning this feature off may help improve performance and save disk space.

ON: Fortnite will automatically download high resolution textures.

OFF: Fortnite will not automatically download high resolution textures.
FortSetting.EasyLootGridEnabled_Description: Enables a scrollable widget where nearby items are shown. You can then pickup an item from there by clicking on it rather than having to click on the actual item widget on the scene.
FortSetting.EnergySavingIdle_Description: Enables energy savings when the game goes into idle mode in the FrontEnd. Idle mode starts after 30 seconds of inactivity.
FortSetting.EnergySavingFocus_Description: Enables energy savings when the game window is not the active window.
FortSetting.GyroV2AdvancedEnabled_Description: Enables or Disables Advanced Gyro Options.
FortSetting.GyroV2Enabled_Description_Switch: Enables or Disables Gyro Aiming. When active, turn your controller to turn the camera. This offers more precision than Right Stick aiming, but doesn't have to replace it entirely. Usually players will still use the Right Stick for most camera control while using gyro aiming for finer adjustments that are difficult to do with a stick.

FortSetting.PlayerSurveys_Description: Enables or disables whether or not you receive periodic player surveys from Epic Games in game. Player surveys are optional and help guide the development of Fortnite.
FortSetting.Vsync_Description: Enabling Vsync eliminates screen tearing by always rendering and presenting a full frame. Disabling Vsync can give higher frame rate and better input response, but can result in horizontal screen tearing.
FortSetting.CameraAssists_Description: Enabling camera assists means the camera will actively turn as you move your character around, so that you don't have to manually control the camera unless trying to aim at something.
FortSetting.AutoCenter_Description: Enabling this setting will pull the camera towards the horizon when you're moving about and not aiming or firing. This can help new players who find themselves unintentionally staring at the ground or sky, or flick stick players who only have gyro aiming active in certain aim modes.
FortSetting.ExperimentalWarning: Experimental feature for this game mode.
FortSetting.WarningAboutEnableFlickStick_Message_Swi:
Flick Stick can only turn the camera left and right. When Flick Stick is enabled, you can only look up and down using gyro controls.

In order to be able to look up and down at all times, we strongly recommend Flick Stick players set their Gyro Active Modes to ALWAYS or set Right Stick Effect to ENABLES. This lets you activate gyro aiming at any time by engaging the Flick Stick.

FortSetting.WarningAboutEnableFlickStick_Message_PS4:
Flick Stick can only turn the camera left and right. When Flick Stick is enabled, you can only look up and down using gyro controls.

In order to be able to look up and down at all times, we strongly recommend Flick Stick players set their Gyro Active Modes to ALWAYS or set right stick Effect to ENABLES. This lets you activate gyro aiming at any time by engaging the Flick Stick.
FortSetting.WarningAboutEnableFlickStick_MessageMobi:
Flick Stick requires playing with a controller. Since Flick Stick also requires your mobile device's gyro for gyro aiming, enabling Flick Stick on mobile is only recommended for players who can mount their mobile device on their controller.

Flick Stick can only turn the camera left and right. When Flick Stick is enabled, you can only look up and down using gyro controls.

In order to be able to look up and down at all times, we strongly recommend Flick Stick players set their Gyro Active Modes to ALWAYS or set Look Stick Effect to ENABLES. This lets you activate gyro aiming at any time by engaging the Flick Stick.
FortSetting.ReleaseToFire_Description: For sniper rifles. Instead of firing when you press the touch look & fire button, fire sniper rifles when you release the look & fire button. This means you can line up the shot with one finger and then fire with that same finger by releasing. Other fire buttons will still fire on press.
FortSetting.ContinuousFireGameplay_Description: For weapons that require you to release and press the trigger again for each shot, enabling this setting lets you just hold the trigger to fire repeatedly (at a reduced firing rate).
FortSetting.PredownloadCosmetics_Description:
Fortnite streams in cosmetic textures as they are encountered in-game. By turning this feature on, you will pre-download all of these textures up front instead of as they are encountered. This uses much more disk space but allows Fortnite to look more detailed without costing any bandwidth. This can improve Fortnite's visual quality if you frequently play using a cellular connection.

No: Fortnite will uninstall any previously downloaded cosmetic textures and will not pre-download them in the future.

Yes: Fortnite will download and install all high-quality textures up front.
FortSetting.ParsleyIdle_Description: Fortnite will go into Sleep Mode after you are inactive for the selected number of minutes. This setting applies to all devices where you are signed in.
FortSetting.FlickForwardDeadZone_Description: Forward angle where pointing the Flick Stick won't flick the camera (degrees).
FortSetting.FrameRateLimit_Description: Frame rate limit sets the highest frame rate that is allowed. Set this lower for a more consistent frame rate or higher for the best experience on faster machines. You may need to disable Vsync to reach high frame rates.
FortSetting.DisableSetting_GameCacheInGame: Game assets cannot be removed during gameplay.
FortSetting.EnableDLSSFrameGeneration_Description: Generates an additional frame for each rendered frame. Requires an NVIDIA 40 series RTX GPU
FortSetting.ShowChatPush_DescriptionMobile: Get notified when you have direct messages, group messages and group invites.
FortSetting.ShowInvitesPush_DescriptionMobile: Get notified when you have party invites or friend requests.
FortSetting.AutorunLockZonePreference_Description:
Gives the user the ability to keep running without requiring constant input.
Activate the Auto Run functionality by dragging your finger over the Auto Run Lock Zone while moving forward.

<strong>OFF</>: The Auto Run Lock Zone functionality is disabled.
<strong>CUSTOM</>: The Auto Run Lock Zone can be positioned manually through the HUD Layout Tool.
<strong>FIXED</>: The Auto Run Lock Zone is positioned above the move stick.

FortSetting.GlobalIllumination_Description:
Global Illumination controls the quality of ambient lighting.

The 'Lumen High' and 'Lumen Epic' options are much higher quality, but can reduce performance.

Off: Ambient lighting is unshadowed.

Ambient Occlusion: Lower quality ambient lighting with darkened corners.

Lumen High/Epic: High quality real-time global illumination.
FortSetting.TurnOnNotifications_Description:
Go to your device settings to turn notifications on.

When enabled, you will be notified when content downloads have completed, friend and party invites, new seasons, limited time events, announcements and promotions. Configure these at any time here in Fortnite Settings.

FortSetting.DualShock4RequiredForGyro: Gyro Aiming on Windows requires a DUALSHOCK®4 controller or DualSense™ controller.
FortSetting.GyroAccelMaxThreshold_Description: Gyro aiming at this speed (in degrees per second) or faster will be multiplied by the Acceleration Multiplier if it's greater than 1, making your fast aiming even faster.
FortSetting.GyroAccelMinThreshold_Description: Gyro aiming at this speed (in degrees per second) or slower will be multiplied by the Acceleration Multiplier if it's less than 1, slowing your slow aiming even more.
FortSetting.GyroAccelMultiplier_Description:
Gyro aiming multiplier depending on how fast you're aiming. If this multiplier is greater than 1, it'll increase the sensitivity of your fast aiming (at or above the Max Threshold). If it's less than 1, it will decrease the sensitivity of your slow aiming (at or below the Min Threshold).

Aim speeds between the two thresholds reduce the effect of the multiplier. No fast multiplier is applied at or below the Min Threshold, and no slow multiplier is applied at or above the Max Threshold.
FortSetting.GyroControlsRequiredForFlickStick: Gyro aiming must be enabled to use Flick Stick.
FortSetting.GyroCheatSensitivity_Description: Gyro aiming sensitivity. Choose 1 for the camera to turn the same amount as the controller (unless using the Legacy acceleration mode).
FortSetting.GyroV2Sensitivity_Description: Gyro aiming sensitivity. FortSetting.GyroTighteningThreshold_Description: Helps keep your aim steady by reducing gyro aiming speed when your controller is turning very slowly. The threshold is how fast the controller needs to turn to disable this tightening effect (in degrees per second), and this effect can be disabled entirely by setting the threshold to 0. Gyro Deadzone is added to this threshold so that if both are enabled, Tightening provides a smooth transition out of the deadzone.

FortSetting.GyroV2SpaceHandheld_Description_Switch:
How the motion inputs are converted to camera Yaw and Pitch rotations when playing in Handheld Mode.

LOCAL space means rotation is detected from the Nintendo Switch console's point of view, and will work the same whether you're lying down, sitting up, in zero gravity, etc. This means it's often the best option for handheld mode.

WORLD space detects motion relative to the direction of gravity, adapting to your position.

PLAYER space combines the precision of LOCAL space with the adaptiveness of WORLD space, making it often preferred for playing with a controller in TV mode or tabletop mode.
FortSetting.GyroV2SpaceHandheld_Description_Switch2:
How the motion inputs are converted to camera Yaw and Pitch rotations when playing in Handheld Mode.

LOCAL space means rotation is detected from the Nintendo Switch 2 console's point of view, and will work the same whether you're lying down, sitting up, in zero gravity, etc. This means it's often the best option for handheld mode.

WORLD space detects motion relative to the direction of gravity, adapting to your position.

PLAYER space combines the precision of LOCAL space with the adaptiveness of WORLD space, making it often preferred for playing with a controller in TV mode or tabletop mode.
FortSetting.GyroV2SpaceSwitch2_Description:
How the motion inputs are converted to camera Yaw and Pitch rotations when playing with a Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller or Joy‑Con 2 controllers detached from the console.

LOCAL space means rotation is detected from the Nintendo Switch 2 console's point of view, and will work the same whether you're lying down, sitting up, in zero gravity, etc. This means it's often the best option for handheld mode.

PLAYER space will detect motion relative to the direction of gravity, giving you the most freedom of movement and the most natural camera control when you're playing with a controller in TV mode or tabletop mode.
FortSetting.GyroV2SpaceSwitch_Description:

FortSetting.GyroV2Space_Description:

FortSetting.GyroButtonHoldTime_Description: If the Gyro Modifier button is shared with a short-press action, this is how long the button needs to be held to skip the short-press action.
FortSetting.GyroCalibrationContext_Description2:
If the motion sensor's zero point isn't calibrated correctly, it can give the wrong values and aim incorrectly. The system automatically detects when the controller is still to recalibrate. This can sometimes have false positives during slow and steady movements, so this setting determines when calibration can happen:

ANY TIME means motion sensor recalibration may occur at any time, even while aiming if your aim is very steady.

MENUS ONLY means motion sensor recalibration won't happen during regular gameplay. To calibrate during gameplay, open the sidebar or menu and then put the controller down for about 3 seconds.
FortSetting.GyroCalibrationContext_Description3:
If the motion sensor's zero point isn't calibrated correctly, it can give the wrong values and aim incorrectly. The system automatically detects when the controller is still to recalibrate. This can sometimes have false positives during slow and steady movements, so this setting determines when calibration can happen:

ANY TIME means motion sensor recalibration may occur at any time, even while aiming if your aim is very steady.

MENUS ONLY means motion sensor recalibration won't happen during regular gameplay. To calibrate during gameplay, open the sidebar or menu and then put the controller down for about 3 seconds.

LOCKED locks in the current motion sensor calibration, making sure it won't change unless the game is stopped or the controller is disconnected. To reset your calibration, change this setting to ANY TIME or MENUS ONLY (no need to press APPLY), put the controller down for about 3 seconds, and then change this setting back to LOCKED to lock it in.

FortSetting.ShowTextChat_Description:
Sets scope of other players you wish to text chat with. You can only send Direct Messages to and receive Direct Messages from players on your friends list. 

<strong>Everybody</>: You can send text chat messages to and receive text chat messages from everyone in Game and Party Channels.

<strong>Friends and Teammates</>: You can send text chat messages to and receive text chat messages from friends and teammates in Game and Party Channels. Team size will vary depending on the experience, ranging from a couple of players to all participants in a game session. You can view the list of team members in the Sidebar.

<strong>Friends Only</>: You can send text chat messages to and receive text chat messages from your friends in Game and Party Channels. Players who are not friends with you won't be able to send you text chat messages, and they won't receive your messages.

<strong>Off</>: Text chat and text reporting are off.

<strong>About Text Reporting</>
When text reporting is on, it enables the contents of your text chat channels to be sent to Epic Games only if a participant reports a violation. Text reporting is usually on, except in Direct Messages and parties formed among friends where all players prefer text reporting off. You can see if text reporting is currently on or off in the text input field before typing a message. Text reporting is always on for players under 18.{0}

See the text reporting setting for more details and options.
FortSetting.VoiceChat_ExpandedSettings_Description:
Sets scope of other players you wish to voice chat with.

<strong>Everybody</>: You can hear everyone and can also talk to them by using a microphone.

<strong>Friends and Teammates</>: You can hear friends and teammates and can also talk to them by using a microphone.

<strong>Friends Only</>: You can hear friends and can also talk to them by using a microphone.

<strong>Nobody</>: Epic voice chat is disabled.
FortSetting.VoiceChat_VRR_ExpandedSettings_Descripti:
Sets scope of other players you wish to voice chat with. Turning on chat also turns on voice reporting.

<strong>Everybody</>: You can hear everyone and can also talk to them by using a microphone.

<strong>Friends and Teammates</>: You can hear friends and teammates and can also talk to them by using a microphone. Team size will vary depending on the experience, ranging from a couple of players to all participants in a game session. You can view the list of team members in the Sidebar.

<strong>Friends Only</>: You can hear friends and can also talk to them by using a microphone.

<strong>Off</>: Voice chat and voice reporting is off.

<strong>About voice reporting</>
When voice chat is on, voice reporting stores voice chat audio on each participant's device on a rolling five-minute basis, which will be sent to Epic Games only if a participant reports a violation. Voice reporting is usually on, except in parties formed among friends where all players prefer voice reporting off. You can see if voice reporting is currently on or off in the Sidebar. Voice reporting is always on for players under 18.

See the voice reporting setting for more details and options.

FortSetting.AllowPersonalizationExperience_Descripti:
This setting allows the messages you receive about Fortnite experiences to be personalized. Examples of these types of messages would be announcements or recommendations for Fortnite in-game events we think you might like.

<strong>ON</>: Messages about Fortnite experiences can be personalized

<strong>OFF</>: Messages about Fortnite experiences will not be personalized
FortSetting.AllowPersonalizationPurchase_Description:
This setting allows you to see Fortnite Item Shop offers we think you might like. You’ll also receive personalized emails or in-game messages about offers and new items coming to the shop.

<strong>ON</>: You will receive personalized offers or messages in Fortnite.

<strong>OFF</>: You will still see offers and receive messages, but they will not be personalized.
FortSetting.TapQuickEditWarning: This setting does not affect controllers when using the default binding to confirm edits.
FortSetting.AllowDiscoveryPersonalization_Descriptio:
This setting enables you to receive Island and Creator Recommendations based upon information we have about you and your play history.

<strong>ON</>: You will receive additional Island and Creator recommendations based upon information we have about you and your play history.

<strong>OFF</>: You will not receive additional Island and Creator recommendations based upon information we have about you and your play history. You can still customize your recommendations using favorited Collections.
FortSetting.SocialStatus_PartyJoinability_Descriptio:
This setting is for how players join your party.

<strong>Invite Only</>: You or someone in your party have to invite players or accept their requests to join in order for them to join the party.

<strong>Friends</>: Players on your friends list and friends of party members will be able to join your party at any time.

NOTE: A party can always be joined via invite.
FortSetting.MatureLanguageFilter_Description:
This setting lets you filter mature language in text chat messages in Party Channels and Direct Messages. The Mature Language filter will always be on in Game Channels and for players under 13.

When this setting is active, mature language that you send or receive will be replaced with heart symbols.


<strong>ON</>: Mature language will be filtered and replaced with heart symbols.
<strong>OFF</>: Mature language can appear in text chat.
FortSetting.FilterMatureLanguage_Desc:
This setting lets you filter mature language in text chat messages in Party Channels and Direct Messages. The Mature Language filter will always be on in Game Channels.

When this setting is active, mature language that you send or receive will be replaced with heart symbols.


<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">ON</>: Mature language will be filtered and replaced with heart symbols.
<text color="00FFD6FF" fontface="black" case="upper" size="20">OFF</>: Mature language can appear in text chat.
FortSetting.PIIFilter_Description:
This setting lets you filter personal information, like email addresses and credit card numbers, in text chat messages in Party Channels and Direct Messages. When this setting is active, certain types of personal information that you send or receive will be replaced with heart symbols.

The Personal Information filter will always be on in Game Channels and for players under the age of 13. 

<strong>ON</>: Personal information will be filtered and replaced with heart symbols.
<strong>OFF</>: Personal information can appear in text chat.
FortSetting.PreferredFilledMatchAudioChannel_Descrip:
This setting only applies when you choose to play a mode while already in a party and have Fill turned ON.

Fill is when your empty slots are filled with random players. Note: this setting does not apply when playing a game mode by yourself.

<strong>GAME:</>

By selecting this Game setting your voice chat will leave the Party Channel and automatically be switched into the Game Channel and you will be able to chat with the random players on your team.

<strong>PARTY:</>

By selecting this Party setting you will stay in the Party Voice Channel and will have to manually switch to the Game Channel in order to chat with the random players on your team.
FortSetting.FlickSmoothingThreshold_Description: Threshold above which no smoothing will be applied to rotations (rotations per second).

FortSetting.QuickWeaponOnPress_Description:
To select your primary weapon, press and release the Quick Weapon button without pressing one of the other weapon buttons. By default, the primary weapon is only selected after releasing the Quick Weapon button, and not the instant it is pressed. This is to help players learn to press button combos to select other weapons. But for those who want to switch to their primary weapon as quickly as possible, enable this setting. This will equip your primary weapon the instant Quick Weapon is pressed.

This has no effect on selecting slots 2-5, which already happen the instant the corresponding button is pressed.

FortSetting.TSR_Description:
Unreal Engine's Temporal Super Resolution displays similarily detailed images with reduced load on your GPU for each frame. When enabled, it allows you to prioritize performance or quality.

Recommended (default): Selects the 3D resolution based what works best for your display resolution.

Performance: Prioritise frame rate over final image quality by rendering at lower resolution.

Balanced: Balances the image quality versus performance.

Quality: Prioritise final image quality over performance by rendering at higher resolution.

Native: Allows you to render frames at the native display resolution at the expense of performance.

Custom: Allows you to customize the 3D resolution on a slider.

If YAW or BOTH are selected, pressing the Reset Camera button will flick the camera to face the direction the Left Stick is pointing. FortSetting.TextChatRTR_Description:
While using Fortnite's text chat with text reporting on, players will be able to send the contents of their text chat channels to Epic Games for review of potential violations of our Community Rules.

You can see if text reporting is currently on or off in the text input field before typing a message.

<strong>OFF WHEN POSSIBLE:</> Text reporting will be off in direct messages and Party Channels where all players have text reporting OFF WHEN POSSIBLE.

<strong>ALWAYS ON:</> Text reporting will be on in every text chat conversation.

Note that text reporting will be on, regardless of your settings, in Party Channels when at least one player has text reporting set to ALWAYS ON, or when a player is added through Looking For Party, as well as in all Game Channels.{0}

Text reporting is <strong>ALWAYS ON</> for players under 18.

Learn more about text reporting here: https://fn.gg/voice-text-reporting
FortSetting.VoiceChatRVR_Description:
While using Fortnite's voice chat with voice reporting on, each participant's device will capture and store voice chat audio on a rolling five - minute basis, which will be sent to Epic Games only if a participant reports a chat violation to help us evaluate the report.

You can see if voice reporting is currently on or off in the Sidebar.

<strong>ALWAYS ON</> : Voice reporting will be on in every voice chat conversation.

<strong>OFF WHEN POSSIBLE</> : Voice reporting will be off in parties formed among friends where all players have voice reporting OFF WHEN POSSIBLE.

Voice reporting will be on if party chats include a player with voice reporting ALWAYS ON or a player added through Looking for Party.Voice reporting will also be on in all game channels.
Learn more about Voice Reporting here : {0} 

Voice reporting is always on for players under 18.

<strong>All ages</>: The content of the game offers educational, or cultivating moral character and sentiments for children. The content and motif of the game have no representation of obscenity, violence, or reproduction of gambling spirit that harms children at all.

FortSettingValueDiscreteSupervised.Russia_SETTING_DESCRIPTION:
Set the content rating for all devices using this account. Experiences rated higher than the selected rating will require PIN to be unlocked.

<strong>12+</>: These games feature much more of a competitive edge. Game scenarios are set within a historical, futuristic or mythical fairy-tale context, enabling players to distance themselves sufficiently from events. This categorisation includes arcade games, strategy games and role-playing games as well as some military simulations.

<strong>6+</>: These games mostly involve family-friendly games which may be more exciting and competitive (e.g. via faster game speed and more complex tasks), such as racers, simulations, platforms and role-playing games.

<strong>All ages</>: The games do not include depictions of violence and do not confront children with any situations producing sustained anxiety.The atmosphere of children’s games often features friendly and colourful graphics. The more relaxed structure of the game does not put even young children under too much pressure to act. Game tasks are also appropriate for children.

Learn more about ratings: https://www.globalratings.com/ratings-guide-russia

<strong>Friends Only</>: You can voice chat only with your Epic and platform friends.

<strong>About voice reporting</>

FortSettingValueDiscreteSupervised.TextChat_ExpandedSettings_Description:
Sets who you can text chat with in groups, parties, and games. You can only send and receive one-on-one messages with your friends.

{OptionWarning}<strong>Everybody</>: You can text chat with everyone. 

<strong>Friends, team members, and connections</>: You can text chat with: Epic friends, platform friends{Platform}, connections, and everyone on your team. Connections are people who aren’t your direct friends but are linked to you through your friends. Team sizes vary by experience and can range from a few players to everyone in a game.

{OptionDesc}<strong>Friends Only</>: You can text chat only with your Epic and platform friends. 

<strong>Off</>: You can't text chat with anyone.

<strong>About Text Reporting</>
Text reporting enables the contents of your text chats to be sent to Epic Games when someone reports a violation.
Text reporting is usually on, except if everyone in a chat has it turned off. You can check if text reporting is on or off in the message box.
Text reporting is always on for under 18s and in all game chats. In those chats, our systems will automatically detect and report threats of real-world violence, child endangerment, and self-harm to Epic for review.

FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialPrivacy_Region_Description:
Controls visibility of your matchmaking region to other players.

<strong>PRIVATE</>: No one can see your matchmaking region.

<strong>FRIENDS ONLY</>: Only friends can see your matchmaking region.

<strong>PUBLIC</>: Anyone can see your matchmaking region.
FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialPrivacy_MutualFriends_Description:
Controls visibility of your mutual friends to other players.

<strong>PRIVATE</>: No one can see your mutual friends.

<strong>FRIENDS ONLY</>: Only friends can see your mutual friends.

<strong>PUBLIC</>: Anyone can see your mutual friends.
FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialStaus_Online_Description:
Controls visibility of your online status to other players.

<strong>ONLINE</>: Other players see you as online.

<strong>AWAY</>: Other players see you as away.
FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialPrivacy_Badges_Description:
Controls visibility of your passes to other players.

<strong>PRIVATE</>: No one can see your passes.

<strong>FRIENDS ONLY</>: Only friends can see your passes.

<strong>PUBLIC</>: Anyone can see your passes.

<strong>PRIVATE</>: No one can see your language.

<strong>FRIENDS ONLY</>: Only friends can see your language.

<strong>PUBLIC</>: Anyone can see your language.
FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialStaus_GameReadiness_Description:
Controls whether you are playing or sitting out.

<strong>PLAYING</>: You will play the next match.

<strong>SITTING OUT</>: You will not play the next match.
FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialStaus_Lfg_Description:
Controls whether you are visible to other players looking for a party.

<strong>ON</>: You are discoverable by other players looking for a party.

<strong>OFF</>: You are not discoverable by other players looking for a party.
FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialPrivacy_ShareActivity_Description:
Share Activity allows you to share your play history and online presence with the Fortnite community.

ON: When turned on, your online presence will be publicly visible and the games that you are playing will be posted to your Creator page under the Shared Play History section.

OFF: When turned off, your online presence will not be publicly visible. Also, gameplay that occurs when this option is off will not be posted publicly to your Creator Page.
FortSocialProfileSettingRegistry.SocialStatus_PartyJoinability_Descriptio:
This setting is for how players join your party.

<strong>Invite Only</>: You or someone in your party have to invite players or accept their requests to join in order for them to join the party.

<strong>FRIENDS</>: Players on your friends list and friends of party members will be able to join your party at any time.

NOTE: A party can always be joined via invite.

HabaneroStrings.infopanel_progressionbody3: <b>All players in a team earn and lose the same amount of progress.</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody1_c4s4: <b>At the start of every season,</> your ranks in Ranked Modes will reset.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_habanerobody1: <b>Eliminate opponents</> and <b>place highly</> to progress through the ranks.
HabaneroStrings.unlockmodal_body2: <b>Rank up</> to unlock tournament play in the Compete tab.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody1: <b>Season Zero is the start of ranked play</> and we may need to make adjustments periodically.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody2: At the end of Season Zero <b>your ranked progress will be recorded</> for future reference.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody3_c4s4: At the end of each season, your ranked progress will be recorded for future reference.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_tournamentbody3: Check the <b>COMPETE</> tab for upcoming tournaments and eligibility requirements.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_tournamentbody2: Compete to test your skills and earn tournament rewards.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody2_c5s1: Earn a variety of rewards including Sprays, Emoticons, a Pickaxe, and <b>a Backbling that shows off your rank!</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody2_c4s4: Earn a variety of rewards including Sprays, Emoticons, and an <b>Back Bling that shows off your rank!</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody2: Earn a variety of rewards including Sprays, Emoticons, and an <b>Emote that shows off your rank!</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_progressionbody2: Eliminations later in the match are worth more.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody1_c5s1: Every match you can progress towards unlocking unique seasonal rewards in ranked by <b>completing Ranked quests.</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_rewardsbody1: Every match you'll get a <b>Ranked Urgent Quest.</> Unlock unique seasonal rewards by completing them!
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_unrankedhint: Play 1 match to reveal your rank
HabaneroStrings.infomodal_unrankedmessage:
Play one match to 
reveal your rank
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_unrealbody2: Players who achieve this rank cannot be demoted back to Champion during the season.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_progressionbody1: Players who dealt damage to an eliminated player earn a share of the progress.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_leaverpenaltiesbody1:
Players who leave a Ranked Ballistic match early, or disconnect without succeeding to reconnect within a certain time period, will receive a Matchmaking Restriction for Ranked Ballistic, in addition to a Ranked Progression penalty.

Matchmaking Restriction tiers escalate and reset to the prior tier every 12 hours, unless another penalty is incurred.
HabaneroStrings.unlockmodal_body3: Ranked modes follow <b>Tournament Rules</>, which may have different loot and settings than unranked.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_matchmakingbody2: The Team Fill option is only available to solo players in ranked modes.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_unrealbody1: The highest rank is Unreal. Upon reaching this rank, <b>players are granted a global leaderboard rank</> which is displayed with their badge.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_tournamentbody1: Unlock access to more tournaments as you rank up.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_matchmakingbody1:
While in a party, Battle Royale and Reload matchmaking is based on the <b>highest-ranked player in the party.</>
In Ballistic, matchmaking is based on the <b>average rank of the party</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_protectionbody2: With the First Match Loss Protection, your first match <b>will not reduce your Rank progress</> if you perform poorly.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_protectionbody1: You will get a First Match Loss Protection, one for Battle Royale and one for Zero Build, that <b>resets daily at 0:00 UTC.</>
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_habanerobody2: You will have the <b>same rank</> for Battle Royale and Zero Build.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody3: Your final rank in Season Zero will affect your initial rank at the start of the next ranked season.
HabaneroStrings.infopanel_seasonbody2_c4s4: Your final rank in the previous season <b>will affect your initial rank</> at the start of the next season.

RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulRecognitionWasTrainedByAnakin: A Jedi has trained you. A Jedi with a darkness inside of him...
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulGreeting: At last, I will have revenge.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulRecognitionWasTrainedBySameOrde: At last, we will reveal ourselves to the Jedi.
RiftGateSWNpcText.ObiWanConversationEntryForForceTraining: Do you wish the train in the ways of the Force to strengthen your powers?
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinGreetingAlternate2: I can make you more powerful than any Jedi could imagine.
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinConversationEntryForForceTraining: I can show you the power of the Force.
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinRecognitionWasTrainedBySameOrder: I do not fear the dark side as Obi-Wan does.
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinGreetingAlternate1: If you're not with me, you're my enemy.
RiftGateSWNpcText.ObiWanRecognitionWasTrainedByDifferentOr: It was said that you would destroy the Sith, not join them.
RiftGateSWNpcText.ObiWanGreetingAlternate2: Let's get a move on. We've got a battle to win here.
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinRecognitionWasTrainedBySamePerson: Love won't save you. Only your new powers can do that.
RiftGateSWNpcText.ObiWanAcceptForceTraining: May the Force be with you.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulGreetingAlternate1: Peace is a lie, there is only passion.
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinRecognitionWasTrainedByDifferentOr: Something's wrong. You're not the Jedi you should be.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulConversationEntryForForceTraini: The Dark Side offers great power to those willing to seize it.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulDenyTraining: The Force already flows through you.
RiftGateSWNpcText.ObiWanRecognitionWasTrainedBySamePerson: The Force is strong with you.
RiftGateSWNpcText.ObiWanGreetingAlternate3: The Force is strong with you... But you must be trained.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulRecognitionWasTrainedBySamePers: There will be no match for you.
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinGreeting: This is where the fun begins.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulRecognitionWasTrainedByDifferen: You have chosen to train under my enemies. Begone.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulRecognitionWasTrainedByObiWan: You may think I am evil. I am not. I am efficient.
RiftGateSWNpcText.AnakinGreetingAlternate3: You're powerful in the ways of the Force... I can train you.
RiftGateSWNpcText.DarthMaulGreetingAlternate3: You're strong in the ways of the Force. I can show you the dark side...

StringTable_RiftGateSWAhsokaText.AhsokaTanoDeclineForceTraining: I don't control the wants of others.
StringTable_RiftGateSWAhsokaText.AhsokaTanoAcceptForceTraining: I like firsts. Good or bad, they're always memorable.
StringTable_RiftGateSWAhsokaText.AhsokaTanoGreetingAlternate2: May the Force be with you.
StringTable_RiftGateSWAhsokaText.AhsokaTanoGreetingAlternate1: This is a new day. A new beginning.
StringTable_RiftGateSWAhsokaText.AhsokaTanoGreetingAlternate3: When you think you understand the Force, you realize just how little you know.

StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduDeclineForceTraining: A shame you can't feel the Force. You might have made a fine Jedi.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduGreetingAlternate1: Anger only leads to the dark side, and a Jedi must always strive to find peace within.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderRecognitionWasTrainedByDifferentOrd: Be careful not to choke on your aspirations.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousGreetingAlternate2: Did you ever hear the tragedy of Darth Plagueis The Wise?
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduConversationEntryForForceTraining: Do not let fear cloud your judgment, for only through clarity can we find wisdom.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousGreetingAlternate1: Embrace the power of the dark side of the Force.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousAcceptForceTraining: Everything that has transpired has done so according to my design.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduGreetingAlternate3: For the Order and the Republic, I will give anything and everything.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderAcceptForceTraining: Give yourself to the Dark Side.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyGreetingAlternate2: Hope is not lost today. It is found.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyRecognitionWasTrainedByDifferentOrder: I feel the conflict in you. It's tearing you apart.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderDeclineForceTraining: I find your lack of faith disturbing.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyGreetingAlternate1: I'm with the Resistance. We need your help.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyDeclineForceTraining: I've seen your daily routine. You are not busy!
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderConversationEntryForForceTraining: If you could be turned, you would become a powerful ally.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderGreetingAlternate3: If you're not with me, then you're my enemy.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousGreeting: Let the hate flow through you.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduRecognitionWasTrainedBySameOrder: May the Force be with us all.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyRecognitionWasTrainedBySameOrder: May the Force be with you.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousRecognitionWasTrainedBySameOrder: Once more the Sith will rule the galaxy, and we shall have peace.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyGreeting: People keep telling me they know me. I'm afraid no one does.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyConversationEntryForForceTraining: The Force brought me here. It calls to you, just like it called to me.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyRecognitionWasTrainedBySamePerson: The Force will be with you, always.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduGreetingAlternate2: The Sith and the Jedi are similar in almost every way.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduRecognitionWasTrainedByDifferentOrd: The dark side may offer power, but it ultimately leads to destruction.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousConversationEntryForForceTraining: The dark side of the Force is a pathway to many abilities.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduGreeting: The path of a Jedi is not an easy one.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousGreetingAlternate3: There is a great disturbance in the Force.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduDenyTraining: There is nothing I can teach you.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduAcceptForceTraining: We must move quickly if the Jedi Order is to survive.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderGreetingAlternate2: We would be honored if you would join us.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.WinduRecognitionWasTrainedBySamePerson: We're keepers of the peace, not soldiers.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderGreetingAlternate1: You do not yet realize your importance.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousDenyTraining: You have all the power you need, for now.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.VaderDenyTraining: You have been trained by another.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousDeclineForceTraining: You will find that it is you who are mistaken, About a great many things.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.SidiousRecognitionWasTrainedByDifferentO: Your faith in your friends is your weakness.
StringTable_RiftGateSWSidiousText.ReyDenyTraining: Your skill already exceeds what I can teach.
